# Moving an expression that writes to variables is an error.
mv file.go:/x\+1/ NewFunc
-- file.go --
package m

func f() int {
	x := 1
	y := x+1
	return y
}
-- stdout --
diff old/file.go new/file.go
--- old/file.go
+++ new/file.go
@@ -2,6 +2,10 @@

 func f() int {
 	x := 1
-	y := x+1
+	y := NewFunc(x)
 	return y
 }
+
+func NewFunc(x int) int {
+	return x + 1
+}
